records.failureSummary: Blocked at the repository root (sandbox root is /workspace): the write policy still allows only apps/server/, server/, backend/ and src/, so the three artifacts this slice exists to produce at the repository root cannot be written. Evidence from this run: write_file('/package.json') -> "Path is not writable: package.json (allowed: apps/server/, server/, backend/, src/)"; the same denial occurred for a relative "package.json" and for "/test/manifest.test.js". The read scope is wider (apps/server/, server/, backend/, packages/shared/, src/, test/, package.json/), which shows a root manifest is expected but its writable scope was never granted. The command tools are script-only (only node --test and npm run <script>), and npm run test at the root fails with ENOENT /workspace/package.json, so no script-based path can create the missing manifest and no pnpm/npm verification command can run. Acceptance criteria remain unmet: no root package.json with an empty dependencies object plus the start/test/lint/typecheck/build scripts, no node --test test script, no PORT-default-3000 start script, and no committed pnpm-lock.yaml for pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Root cause is environmental (write-policy scope), not a code defect, so a retry with identical tooling cannot help. Work delivered inside the writable scope and re-verified this run: src/server.js, a Node 22 standard-library-only entry point that resolves PORT at the trust boundary (blank, non base-10 integer, and out-of-[1,65535] values fall back to 3000; default 3000) and preserves the exported API (createServer, resolvePort, start, DEFAULT_PORT, MIN_PORT, MAX_PORT) with a stable 404 JSON error envelope; src/server.test.js, which passes 5/5 under node --test from the repository root with exit code 0; and src/tools/selfcheck.js, a dependency-free source walker for the intended lint/typecheck/build scripts. Exact intended contents of the three blocked root files are attached so they can be applied verbatim once root and test/ writes are granted. No CI, container or deployment work was attempted.
